name: Sword and Pistol Flurry (Combat, Style)
body:
You unleash a rapid series of many shots while keeping enemies at bay with your sword.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Snap Shot, Sword and Pistol, Sword and Pistol Sharpness, Two–Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +10.

Benefit(s): When you use Sword and Pistol and Rapid Shot in a round, you can make an additional attack either with your primary hand or off-hand weapon at your highest attack bonus. This stacks with the additional attack granted by Rapid Shot.
